items.title: Pest 5 Released With Test Impact Analysis, Agent Verification, and Evals
items.summary:
Nuno Maduro announced Pest 5 at Laracon US 2026. The PHP testing framework adds test impact analysis, an agent plugin, evals, PHPStan, and Rector support.
The post Pest 5 Released With Test Impact Analysis, Agent Verification, and Evals appeared first on Laravel News.
